description.value: Chengdu Noodle is a Chinese noodle restaurant in Richmond, BC, specializing in noodle dishes rooted in Chengdu-style cuisine. It is located in a commercial unit at 8100 Ackroyd Road, a busy multi-tenant complex in central Richmond. The OSM record notes a strict no-smoking policy on premises.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 32m; rack at 53m; rack (14 spaces) at 62m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The only website URL is an Instagram profile (@chengdunoodle), but the fetched content is entirely Instagram's generic login wall, boilerplate pages, and trending hashtags — no restaurant-specific content was accessible without authentication. All restaurant details therefore rely solely on OSM tags: cuisine=noodle;chinese, smoking=no, and a Richmond address. No amenity evidence is available from either source.
concerns: Website URL points to an Instagram profile that requires login to display any restaurant-specific content; no business information, address, phone, or amenities could be extracted from the fetched pages. All amenity fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible Chinese noodle restaurant in Richmond with an active OSM record and no indication of closure; useful stop for touring cyclists in the area.
